artboards.title: Option A — the This cycle strip
Option B — Progress back in the tab bar
Option C — Progress becomes a tab of You

annotations.text:
THE FINDING

app.jsx:17964 records why Progress left the tab bar, and why that was safe: "nothing daily is lost, because the verdict, the weight spark and the weekly check-in prompt all live on the StatusCard there."

StatusCard no longer exists — that comment is its last mention in the file. The demotion was paid for with a Today presence that was later deleted, and nobody restored it.

OPTION A — recommended

Restore the compensation, not the tab. One strip between the buddy and the plan: verdict, trend weight, 90-day shape, one tap into the full page.

82px at rest. Costs the plan card ~82px of first paint.

Tradeoff: Progress is still not a destination — only a card that leads to one. Pair it with Option C.

OPTION B — Progress back in the tab bar

What you first asked for. Five tabs plus the FAB across 390px: each cell drops to ~63px and PROGRESS at 9px Silkscreen tracked 0.08em does not fit its cell.

And the original argument still stands — a weekly read holding a daily slot. Today still shows nothing about progress; you would tap a tab to learn you are on track.

OPTION C — Progress becomes a tab of You

The strip You already has grows to Progress | Settings | Account, lands on Progress, and the settings-overview card that currently carries it is deleted. Progress stops being a row in a settings list.

Tradeoff: the header button still says YOU behind a gear, which now under-promises what is behind it.
